title: sync: fail on invalid images-by-tag-regex / images-by-semver filters
body:
A bad regex or semver constraint in the sync YAML used to be logged and the whole section (including its valid repositories) silently dropped, and sync still exited 0. Now the error is returned and sync fails, matching how other configuration errors are handled. The yaml branch of imagesToCopy already has an error path for per-registry failures.

Also adds a unit test for both invalid-filter cases. It needs no registry access, since the filters are compiled before any request.

One merge note: please land the ctx-threading fix first ("sync: propagate the command timeout context to tag listing"). Once that's in, this branch needs a small rebase:

- the two filter blocks in sync.go conflict — keep the "return the error" side and put the ctx argument back into the two filterSourceReferences calls
- sync_test.go auto-merges with no conflict, but the new test's imagesToCopyFromRegistry("example.com", cfg, *sourceCtx) call then needs context.Background() as its first argument, or the package won't compile. go vet will point right at it, easy to miss otherwise.

comments.body: Ephemeral COPR build failed. @containers/packit-build please check.

Heads up for whoever merges this: please merge #3017 first, this builds on its context threading.

When merging here:

1. The imagesByTagRegex / imagesBySemver blocks in sync.go will conflict — keep the "return the error" side, and put the ctx argument back into the two filterSourceReferences calls inside those blocks.
2. sync_test.go will auto-merge with no git conflict, but the new test's imagesToCopyFromRegistry("example.com", cfg, *sourceCtx) call then needs context.Background() as its first argument, otherwise go vet and the tests won't compile.
